name: 4K To 1080 Vertical Reel Prep
use_when: Source footage is 4K but the target short-form delivery is 1080x1920 vertical.
External microphone audio must be synchronized before trimming and animation.
A prepared render is needed before After Effects animation begins.
avoid_when: The target platform or user explicitly requires 4K delivery.
The 4K source needs reframing/cropping flexibility throughout the entire edit.
The source is already 1080x1920 with synced audio and stable color.

timeline_pattern.pattern: import_4k_source -> sync_external_audio -> delete_camera_audio -> export_1080x1920_master -> reimport_1080 -> rough_cut -> subtle_color_adjustment_layer -> prepared_render_for_animation
timeline_pattern.sync_rule: Verify mouth movement against the external mic before deleting camera audio.
timeline_pattern.target_rule: Use 1080x1920 for vertical social delivery when the platform does not benefit from a 4K export.
timeline_pattern.prepared_rule: Export a clean prepared version before After Effects so animation work starts from a stable trimmed picture.

motion.rule: Do not lock animation until the prepared 1080 cut is trimmed and stable.

sound.rule: Synchronize external mic audio first, then keep the intended dialogue track unmuted through every prep export.

captions.rule: Caption creation belongs after the edit is close to locked; otherwise caption timing will churn.

color.rule: Use a subtle Lumetri adjustment layer for exposure, contrast, highlights, shadows, whites, and vignette; avoid over-correction.

implementation.ffmpeg: Use ffprobe to verify source streams, then scale/crop/pad to 1080x1920 only after confirming aspect and synced audio. Use loudness checks before prepared export.
implementation.remotion: Use the 4K source as sourceMedia, but render a prepared 1080x1920 intermediate or composition if downstream animation expects HD vertical.
implementation.blender: Use 1080x1920 scene settings for social animation renders unless the final target requires higher resolution.
implementation.capcut_equivalent: Sync external audio, trim the vertical cut, export a 1080 preview/intermediate if moving to another tool.
implementation.premiere_equivalent: Create a 4K sequence for sync/prep, export a 1080x1920 version with maximum depth/quality when needed, reimport it, trim to the reel length, color-correct with an adjustment layer, then export a prepared render for After Effects.

common_mistakes: Editing the entire Reel in a 4K timeline when the target and AE comp are 1080 vertical.
Deleting camera audio before verifying external mic sync.
Exporting a muted dialogue track during the prepared render.
Over-correcting color before animation and making the source look artificial.
Starting captions before the trimmed prepared cut is stable.
qc: External mic audio is synchronized to mouth movement before camera audio is removed.
Prepared render is 1080x1920 when the target is vertical HD social delivery.
Dialogue is audible in the prepared render.
Subtle color correction preserves skin detail and avoids clipped highlights or crushed shadows.
Prepared render duration matches the intended rough cut before After Effects animation begins.
